summary: Alma Mater is a dense engine-builder where you manage two disciples through overlapping worker-placement and tile-drafting systems to grow your school's reputation across four disciplines. It rewards careful long-term planning and combo-building, with turns that can run long as players calculate optimal paths through the tightly interlocking systems.
praised: Rich, tightly interlocking systems that reward planning and optimization
High replayability from variable setup and multiple viable strategies
Satisfying sense of building an efficient engine over the game
Strong production values and thematic presentation for a euro
criticised: Steep learning curve and rules overhead for new players
Analysis paralysis potential due to the many interacting decisions
Downtime between turns in higher player counts
Theme feels pasted onto what is fundamentally an abstract points-optimization puzzle

interaction.kind: mostly parallel play with some worker-placement blocking

scoring.why: Points accumulate from multiple disciplines, student/staff recruitment, prestige tracks, and end-game bonuses simultaneously
